couloir-des-cupules.texte: Discover the first remarkable formations of the underground journey.

salle-blanche.texte: Discover this beautiful chamber and its bright mineral formations shaped over thousands of years.

salle-du-balcon.texte: Discover this spectacular chamber and its impressive formations.

lac-aux-atolls.texte: Admire the underground lake and its reflections, creating a unique atmosphere beneath the mountain.

salle-du-temple-angkor.texte: A monumental chamber whose shapes evoke the famous temples of Asia, sculpted by nature over time.

gouffre.texte: The Balcony of Darkness is a natural viewpoint located at the edge of the majestic Red Dome chamber. From this impressive observation point, visitors can contemplate the endless abyss, a dizzying shaft descending deep into the heart of the mountain.

plafond-des-excentriques.texte: Look up and admire a fascinating phenomenon: the excentrics ceiling. Unlike classic stalactites that grow straight down, these formations extend in every direction, creating a delicate natural lacework.

accueil.sousTitre: Let yourself be guided into the heart of the Catalan mountains
accueil.description: A sound exploration of the underground wonders of the Canalettes Caves
